summary: Full backend + frontend e2e for Research Console. 26/26 pytest tests PASSED including real LLM call (/api/ai/chat → Claude Sonnet 4.6). Frontend: login → significance-audit auto-runs with highlighted mtc_robust ROBUST badges (5 survivors / 192 family), safety banner persistent on every page, navigation across all 5 pages works, logout works. AI Research UI chat verified end-to-end with real Claude reply in ~3s.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error: 'Encountered two children with the same key, XAUUSD'. The instruments list returned by GET /api/instruments contains XAUUSD twice (once from mock_data.instruments() base list and once from db.uploaded_instruments after /api/data/fetch-yahoo XAUUSD created a persisted uploaded copy). React .map keys collide. Frontend should de-dupe by symbol, or backend should merge uploaded over base instead of concatenating.

Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The option content contains JSX that the dev tooling wraps in a span, producing invalid HTML inside <option>. Render option text as a plain string (e.g. `{`${r.run_type} · ${r.created_at.slice(5,16).replace('T',' ')}`}`) without interpolation that may emit a span wrapper, or move the formatting outside.

integration_issues.issue: On a single early attempt the UI received a 502 ('origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare'). The same /api/ai/chat call from curl and pytest returned in ~3s with a valid Claude reply. On retry the UI got a 3s real reply. Looks like a transient ingress/proxy hiccup, not a code bug. Worth monitoring; consider adding a retry / better surface for 502 in AIResearch.jsx send() catch.

action_items: Fix React duplicate-key warning: de-dupe instruments by symbol on the frontend (or merge uploaded over base on backend in /api/instruments).
Fix invalid <span> inside <option> in AIResearch.jsx context-run-select (hydration warning). Use a plain string template literal as the option's child.
critical_code_review_comments: analysis.py /api/instruments concatenates uploaded_instruments AFTER the base mock list — duplicates accumulate every time a user fetches/uploads a symbol that already exists in mock_data.instruments(). Merge by symbol (uploaded overrides) or de-dupe to keep payload clean.
ai_research.py /api/ai/chat raises HTTP 502 on LLM failure (good) but UI only shows the raw detail text. Consider returning a stable error code so the UI can show 'LLM upstream busy — retry'.
auth.py login lockout: identifier is ip:email which is reasonable, but proxy IPs behind ingress may be shared; consider using only email for lockout or trusting X-Forwarded-For.
Both /api/health and /api/safety hard-code live_armed=false / allow_real_live=false and there is genuinely NO arming endpoint anywhere — absolute constraint verified.
No data-testid on safety banner verified to be 'safety-banner' — present and visible on every authenticated page.
test_credentials: admin@research.console / ResearchAdmin2025 (seeded admin) — confirmed working. Self-register also confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_CSV uploaded instrument, several TESTSYNxxxx synthetic instruments, and a few persisted runs (significance/edge/ny/overnight). Not cleaned up — they are harmless mock-source records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_research_console.py (pytest, 26 tests, all green in ~7s). It includes a real LLM call. Frontend BASE_URL = https://research-console-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Login auto-fills admin creds. The two outstanding items are React console warnings only — no functional impact. AI chat both via curl and via the UI returned real Claude replies in <5s on retry. If you see a 502 in the UI on first chat call, retry — it's the proxy, backend works.
rca of the issue: Duplicate-key warning RCA: /api/instruments response = mock_data.instruments() + db.uploaded_instruments (concat). Once any test/user hits /api/data/fetch-yahoo with symbol XAUUSD (which exists in the mock base list), the same symbol appears twice in the array. Frontend uses key={r.symbol} in the .map, hence the React warning. Fix: in analysis.py /api/instruments, build a dict keyed by symbol and have uploaded entries override base entries, then return list(merged.values()). Or, on the frontend, de-dupe before render.
